appDesc.message: Your X account and follower changes in the side panel. Local snapshots, read-only, no API key.
appDesc.description: Extension description, shown on the chrome://extensions card

panelUpdated.description: Footer line: when the numbers were last read

panelNoFollowers.description: Footer line shown while the counts are still missing

panelHint.message: Use refresh in the top right. It loads your profile once and reads the numbers back.

emptyTitle.message: Your account has not been read yet

emptyBody.message: Open x.com in this browser and sign in. Your avatar and follower count will appear here on their own.

openX.description: Tooltip on the button that opens x.com

refreshNoAccount.message: No account yet, open x.com first

refreshTimeout.message: No new numbers arrived. Check that you are signed in and try again.

refreshBusy.message: Already refreshing, give it a moment

refreshTabFailed.message: Could not open x.com. Open it yourself once.

timeNow.description: Relative time, less than a minute ago

followersTitle.description: Heading of the follower changes card

followersEmpty.message: Read your followers in a temporary background tab. Save locally and compare next time.

followersFirst.message: First snapshot saved. The next capture will show who changed.

followersSame.message: Nobody left or arrived since the last capture.

followersCaveat.message: Missing accounts may also be deactivated, suspended or blocked.

captureIncomplete.message: Could not verify a complete list. Previous snapshots kept. Refresh numbers and try again.

captureIncompleteOf.message: Read $CAPTURED$, but X reports $EXPECTED$. Previous snapshots kept. Try again.

captureBusy.message: Already reading the list, give it a moment

captureTimeout.message: The list took too long to read, try again

captureNoAnswer.message: The followers page did not respond, try again

captureNoCount.message: Read $COUNT$ people, but could not read an exact follower total. Check that you are signed in to X and try again. Previous snapshots kept.

captureNoPages.message: Could not read the first followers page. Check that your followers page opens on X and try again. Previous snapshots kept.

captureFormat.message: Could not recognize X's follower data after reading $COUNT$ people. Previous snapshots kept.

captureOwner.message: Could not confirm that the list belongs to this account. Open your followers page on X and try again. Previous snapshots kept.

captureCountChanged.message: The follower total changed during capture. Try again. Previous snapshots kept.

captureStopped.message: The list did not reach the end ($COUNT$ people, $PAGES$ pages). Try again later. Previous snapshots kept.

captureLimit.message: The list exceeds 30,000 people or the local storage limit. Previous snapshots kept.

captureStorage.message: Could not save to local storage. Previous snapshots kept. Free some space and try again.

captureAccountChanged.message: The signed-in account changed. Nothing was saved; capture again for the current account.

captureFailed.message: Capture failed. Previous snapshots kept. Check x.com and try again.
